before.question: What happens after I request a demo?
before.answer: Our team contacts you to arrange a personalized demo around your workflow. We then discuss the appropriate modules, setup requirements, and whether trial access or a paid plan fits. You do not need an account or payment to request a demo.

before.question: What do the subscription prices cover?
before.answer: The prices cover the software modules listed in each plan and onboarding support. We confirm user and location limits, migration, customization, integrations, and applicable taxes for your requirements before you commit. Trial and direct-purchase conditions are available in the pricing section without registration.

before.question: Is LoomIQ built for cloth manufacturers?
before.answer: Yes. LoomIQ is designed for fabric mills, dyeing and processing units, garment manufacturers, home-textile businesses, and textile traders that need commercial, factory, stores, and finance data connected.

before.question: Can it handle raw material and finished goods inventory?
before.answer: Yes. You can manage yarn, fabric, trims, dyes, chemicals, packaging, work in progress, rolls, batches, and finished goods across stores and locations.

before.question: Can we track production and quality stages?
before.answer: Yes. The workflow can cover material issue, production stages, dyeing or finishing, inspection, rejection, rework, approval, and dispatch. The exact setup depends on your process.

before.question: Can LoomIQ show the cost and margin of an order?
before.answer: LoomIQ is designed to connect material, purchase, wastage, production, dispatch, and finance records so your team can review the cost and margin behind an order.

before.question: Can it support multiple stores or manufacturing units?
before.answer: The platform supports location-based stock and workflows. Multi-unit and multi-company requirements can be configured with the appropriate permissions, approvals, and reporting.

after.question: Is LoomIQ designed for garment manufacturers?
after.answer: Yes. LoomIQ is positioned specifically for garment and clothing manufacturers, bringing orders, inventory, production, and accounts into one ERP.

after.question: Can a small manufacturer buy online?
after.answer: Yes. Starter and Growth can be purchased on this website without a sales call. Review pricing and the setup conditions before paying.

after.question: What is the difference between Starter and Growth?
after.answer: The regular monthly prices are {starterRegular} and {growthRegular}. Detailed user limits and verified module entitlements have not been supplied; confirm any essential feature or limit with support before choosing a plan.

after.question: Can I manage production, inventory, and orders?
after.answer: These are core areas of the product brief. The current preview does not demonstrate garment-specific screens. Confirm your required production workflow before purchasing.

after.question: Does LoomIQ support job work, employees, or cutting and stitching stages?
after.answer: Those detailed capabilities have not yet been verified in the available product materials. Do not assume they are included in either plan.

after.question: Can I import my existing spreadsheets?
after.answer: An ERP data-import workflow and migration terms have not been supplied. Ask support about your data format and migration needs before purchase.

after.question: Is LoomIQ cloud-based?
after.answer: This website and customer account run in your browser. The team provides your ERP workspace link after setup; confirm deployment requirements if these matter to your factory.

after.question: What happens immediately after payment?
after.answer: After Razorpay confirms payment, you can view and save your invoice. Your customer account shows onboarding progress. Our team arranges ERP access; payment does not instantly create a workspace.

after.question: Do I need technical knowledge? Is onboarding included?
after.answer: The current plans describe onboarding support. You can track setup in your account. A setup completion time and training scope have not been specified.

after.question: How does the first-purchase offer work?
after.answer: Eligible first purchases receive {discount} off within 24 hours of the first offer visit: Starter {starterOffer} or Growth {growthOffer} for one month. The server records the deadline; refreshing does not restart it. Trial accounts can qualify if they have not purchased.

after.question: How do payments and renewals work?
after.answer: Pay the INR total displayed at checkout through Razorpay. Each purchase covers one membership month. This website does not automatically charge for renewal.

after.question: Can I cancel or get a refund?
after.answer: There is no automatic renewal to cancel. The existing refund policy says discounted first-month payments are generally non-refundable. Email support with your order reference for payment or service issues; read the full refund policy before purchase.

after.question: How is my account protected?
after.answer: Customer accounts use hashed passwords, expiring sessions, and password recovery. Invoices require the purchasing account. Razorpay handles payment details. These website controls do not establish a security certification for the ERP.

after.question: How do I get support?
after.answer: Email loomiq2025@gmail.com. After purchase, the confirmation page also provides a support request form. No response-time guarantee is published.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes the information used for LoomIQ accounts, demo and trial requests, membership purchases, support, and website analytics.
sections: Information we collect

We collect the contact and company details you submit, a password hash for your account, billing address and phone number at checkout, payment references, invoices, and messages you send to support. We store visitor and session identifiers in essential cookies. Card details are handled by Razorpay rather than stored by this website.
How we use information

We use this information to authenticate accounts, manage offer eligibility, arrange demos and onboarding, confirm payments, provide invoices, respond to support requests, and protect the service from abuse.
Service providers and analytics

Our database, hosting, email, and payment providers process information needed to deliver these services. When you enable optional analytics, Google Analytics receives page views and interaction events. Our custom analytics events do not include your form fields or payment details. You can change your analytics preference on this website.
Retention and requests

Account, inquiry, and transaction records are retained to operate the service and maintain payment records. To request access, correction, or deletion, email loomiq2025@gmail.com. We may need to verify account ownership and retain records needed for unresolved transactions or applicable recordkeeping obligations.
Account security
Keep your password and email account secure. Password reset links expire after 30 minutes and can be used once. Resetting your password invalidates existing login sessions.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms describe website use, account registration, membership checkout, and the onboarding process for LoomIQ.
sections: Website content
LoomIQ provides this website and preview content for general informational purposes. Product details, features, and availability may change as our platform evolves.
Demo requests
Submitting a demo request does not create a customer relationship, guarantee product access, pricing, or final contract terms unless expressly agreed in writing.
Accounts

Provide accurate contact and billing information and keep your login credentials private. Contact support if you suspect unauthorized access. Do not use the website to interfere with other accounts or the operation of the service.
Membership payments

Checkout purchases one membership month at the amount displayed before payment. This website does not automatically charge for later months. Additional purchases require a new checkout. Payment confirmation and invoices are available in your account.
Offer conditions

The purchase discount lasts 24 hours from the first offer visit and does not renew daily. Trial accounts can use the discount during that window. Payment must complete before the deadline stored for the order; late captured discounted payments are submitted for refund.
Access and onboarding

Creating an account or making a payment does not instantly create an ERP workspace. Our team arranges onboarding and provides access after setup. Your account shows progress and a workspace link when access is ready. Contact support to agree on setup and service dates before purchase if timing is essential.
Support and billing questions
Contact loomiq2025@gmail.com for account, payment, or service questions. The Refund Policy describes cancellation requests and payment issues.

refunds.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refunds.intro: This policy explains one-time membership payments, cancellation requests, and payment refunds.
sections: One-time payments
Each checkout purchases one membership month. There are no automatic renewals or automatic charges from this website. To purchase another month, complete a new checkout at the displayed price.
Cancellation

You do not need to cancel an automatic renewal. For an existing membership, onboarding cancellation, or an access issue, contact support with your account email and order reference so the team can review your request.
Refunds

The discounted first-month payment is generally non-refundable after payment. If you believe a payment was made in error or a service issue affected your account, contact support promptly so the request can be reviewed.
Expired offer payments

Captured discounted payments completed after their order deadline are submitted to Razorpay for a full refund. A submitted refund may take time to reach your payment method. Contact support with your payment reference if you need a status update.
Support
For cancellation or billing help, email loomiq2025@gmail.com with your account email and company name.
